concern: (low) Hero media element relies on static relative image path without progressive inline vector placeholder during asset fetch
jtbd: When accessing the application on high-latency connections, I want the hero media container to display an inline progressive vector placeholder, so that perceptual layout stability is preserved and visual continuity is maintained during asset fetch.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the hero media container in mockup.html, When the hero image is in the process of downloading, Then an inline lightweight SVG vector placeholder is rendered within the container maintaining aspect ratio without layout shift or blank flashing.

concern: (low) Form controls container could introduce semantic fieldset and legend tags to enhance screen-reader navigation scalability
jtbd: When navigating form inputs using assistive technologies, I want related controls to be grouped within semantic fieldset and legend tags, so that the form context and group purpose are programmatically discernible.
